critique.evidence: Across desktop, tablet, and mobile, automated checks report no confirmed accessibility violations, no touch-target violations, no viewport-level or uncontained overflow, and the wide atlas board is contained by its scroll region. However, color contrast remains unverified with a serious incomplete result affecting 77 atlas nodes on desktop, 43 on tablet, and 35 on mobile, including headings, instructions, filters, labels, and graph nodes. No measured keyboard traversal, activation, focus-order, focus-visibility, or scroll-region operability results were supplied. No reduced-motion evidence was supplied.
critique.fix: Measure and remediate contrast against the actual gradient/overlap backgrounds to WCAG AA; then provide Playwright evidence for complete keyboard-only use of filters, stage navigation, vector selection, horizontal scrolling, and the detail action with visible focus and no traps. Add and verify prefers-reduced-motion behavior for every transition or animated graph effect, then rerun WCAG, touch-target, overflow, keyboard, and reduced-motion tests at all three viewports.
